The resume preview and exports use 100% deterministic matching and prewritten canonical text. The same posting, emphasis, and evidence version always produce the same baseline selection—never unverified model-invented resume bullets.

What the match can tell you

Keywords connect a requirement to related career evidence. They do not confirm seniority, minimum years, credentials, or every part of a requirement. Review the source and any qualification notes.

SOAP/XML, REST, and scheduled table-backed publish/subscribe solution review are supported. JSON insurance standards and broker-based or real-time streaming implementation (such as Kafka) are not established. Independent NEXUS work stays separate from employer experience.
